definition: Recognition — the re-cognition of oneself as Śiva. Not learning something new but recognizing what was always the case. The central soteriological act in Kashmir Śaivism: the recognition that one's own consciousness is Śiva's consciousness.

sources.claim: pratyabhijñā as the recognition of oneself as the Lord
pratyabhijñā as the means of liberation in Trika

translations.note: 'Recognition' captures the re-cognitive aspect; 're-cognition' emphasizes the 'again' (prati) — seeing what was always there.
